welcome.title: Welcome to {{name}}
welcome.body: Kredibel reads every statement, invoice, receipt and ledger export twice, checks it, and reconciles each month. This tour shows where everything is.

period.title: Choose the period
period.body: The dashboard shows one month, a range of up to 12 months, or a year. It opens on the current month; here it shows the months that have books.

figures.title: The figures
figures.body: Money in and out, what the accounts kept, and how much Kredibel matched, each against the previous period. Every number comes from code, never from a model.

flow.title: Where the money went
flow.body: The money flow by statement line or by client and supplier, money in and out by month, and the cash-flow statement under IFRS or US GAAP. Select a band to see its bank lines.

upload.title: Upload anything, in any order
upload.body: Drop statements, invoices, receipts or a ledger export. A file sent twice is never read twice, a possible copy waits for you, and a new ledger layout asks for its columns once.

months.title: Reconciliation, month by month
months.body: Each month matches its bank lines with invoices, receipts and the ledger. The same data gives the same result, whatever the upload order.

review.title: What needs a person
review.body: Everything the AI could not settle comes here: a match to confirm, a possible copy, a value to check, columns to confirm. Only a person resolves it.

risk.title: Risk, with its evidence
risk.body: Each month and document gets a risk level. A finding shows the printed value, the calculation and both readings, and what to do next.

clients.title: Clients and suppliers
clients.body: Built from the books: totals by month and the accounts each one was paid into. A supplier paid to a new account is flagged.

labels.title: Labels you can correct
labels.body: Every AI decision is a label: document and page types, categories, values read. Confirm or correct it; a person's label is never overwritten.

runs.title: Runs, like a tracing tool
runs.body: Every document and month run with its steps, model calls, tokens and estimated cost. Open one to see its waterfall.

assistant.title: Ask about your books
assistant.body: The assistant answers from read-only tools over your books, with a citation for every figure.

done.title: You are ready
done.body: Upload your own files any time. Take the tour again with the lightbulb in the top bar.
